verdict.rationale: Granola's docs state that after an external meeting it can automatically draft a follow-up email, using context from the transcript, calendar and past Gmail threads, so you can send it in a couple of clicks. This matches the story nearly verbatim. Granola Chat also drafts and sends follow-up emails, with a review step before anything is sent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the follow-up email drafting quality.
